transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I’m here because I keep hearing this man’s voice. It sounds like it’s coming from the garage vents, or sometimes from under the hood when I’m working. It’s clear, like someone’s right next to me… telling me not to trust my husband, or not to touch certain cars.
Have you ever seen things that others don't, like shadows, people, or objects that aren't really there?
No… not really seeing things. It’s more hearing him. The man’s voice, like from the vents at the garage or under the hood… clear, like he’s right there.
Have you ever experienced any other unusual sensations, like seeing things, feeling something touching you, or smelling something that others don’t?

Not really… not touching or smells. It’s mostly the voice. Like I said, it sounds like it’s coming from the garage vents, or under the hood sometimes… clear, like a man standing right next to me. Telling me not to trust my husband, or not to touch certain cars.
Do you believe that the man speaking to you through the vents is real, or have you ever felt like he is trying to communicate something important that others don't understand?

I… I know it sounds far-fetched. But yes, it feels real to me. I’m still pretty convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the security cameras to keep track of what I’m doing… even when they show me the footage and say there’s nothing there.

Have you ever had any other beliefs that others around you don’t seem to share, such as thinking you are receiving special messages, or that certain events have a special meaning for you specifically?

I guess… yeah. Not special messages exactly, but I still feel like my husband and the shop owner are watching me through the EV chargers and cameras. I know how that sounds, but even when they show me the footage and say nothing’s there, I don’t really believe them.
Have you ever had any other unusual beliefs or ideas that you feel strongly about, even though others don’t seem to share them or understand them?

I mean… yeah, I guess it’s the same thing. I still think my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the cameras to keep track of me. They say the footage doesn’t show anything, but… I don’t really buy that.
Even though others have shown you evidence that the cameras and EV chargers aren’t being used to watch you, do you still feel certain that they are, without any doubt?

Yeah… I mean, I know they say it proves nothing’s happening. But I don’t feel like it proves that to me. I still think they’re using the chargers and cameras to keep tabs on me. I can’t really shake it.
Even though there is clear proof that the cameras and EV chargers aren’t being used to watch you, do you still feel completely certain that they are, without any doubt?
Yeah… I know you’re saying it’s clear proof, but I don’t feel that way. I’m still convinced they’re using the chargers and cameras to track me. I know it sounds far-fetched, but… I can’t shake it.
Even though there is clear proof that the cameras and EV chargers aren’t being used to watch you, do you still feel completely certain that they are, without any doubt?

Yeah. I mean… I know you’re saying there’s proof, and they’ve shown me footage, but I still don’t believe it. I’m still convinced my husband and the shop owner are using the EV chargers and the cameras to track what I’m doing. It sounds far-fetched, I know, but… that’s what I think.
